book.name: Matoosa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Matoosi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: He wode xammaqiza Yohannisi asaas, «Salo kawoteththi matida gishshas intte nagarappe simmite» gi sabbakishe Yuhuda bazzora yides.
Yohannisi gaamella iskefe oosettida may7o may7ees. Ba xeessan dafo gixxees; izi miza qumay degera eessinne boole.
Yerusalaameppe, kumeththa Yuhudappenne Yordaanoose shaafa matan diza dere asay wuri Yohannisakko wodhdhidi,
ba nagarakka izas paaxishe Yordaanoose Shaafan iza kushen xammaqettides.
Daro Farsaawetinne Saduqaaweti izi xammaqizaso yishin be7idi Yohannisi, «Intteno shooshshatoo! Intte sinththara diza hanqofe attana mala inttena ooni bessidee?
Intte intte nagaraappe simmidayssa bessiza ooso ooththite.
‹Nu aaway Abrahaamey nuus dees› gizayssan intterkka inttena baleththofte; ta inttes Xoossi hayta shuchchatappe Abrahaames naa histti denththanaas dandayees gays.
Hekko kalttay qanxxanaas miththata garsan giigetti uttides; hessa gishshas lo7o ayfe ayfontta miththi wuri qanxxettananne taman yegettana.
Tani maaroteththas haaththan xammaqays; haray attoshin ta iza caamma tookkanaas bessonttaadey taappe aadhdhiza minoy guyera yaana; izikka Xillo Ayananinne taman inttena xammaqana.
iza kushen dees; izikka ba kaththa baleza pitti geeshshana; ba gisttezakka di7en qolana; happaa gidikko to7ontta taman xuuggana» gides.
He wode Yesusi Yohannisan xammaqettanaas Galilappe Yordaanoose shaafa bides.
Gido attiin Yohannisi, «Hayssi hanenna; tani nenan xammaqettana bessishin neni waanada taakko yay?» giidi izara marshettides.
Yesusikka, «Aykkoy baa, ero garkkii? Hayssa ooththidi nuni xilloteth ubbaa polanaas nuus bessees» gides. Yohannisikka iza qofaa ero gi ekkides.
Yesusi xammaqettidi haaththaafe kezida mala heerakka saloy doyettiin Xoossa Ayanay haraphphe misatidi iza bolla wodhdhishin be7ides.
Saloppeka, «Tani izan ufayettiza Naazinne ta siiqiza ta Naazi hayssa» giza qaalay siyettides.

footnotes.text: Kath suraggiza layda gizayssa amaraththo birsheththay menshe gees; hessa gishshas nuni layda gizayssa mislen go7ettidos.
